# House Of Wax

> House Of Wax is a marketplace and culture platform for vinyl records, music collectibles, and merch, connecting independent sellers with buyers. Sellers are paid directly by buyers through PayPal — House Of Wax does not hold or process funds itself.

House Of Wax is live at https://shophouseofwax.com/ and the marketplace application itself is at https://house-of-wax-clean-5rqkikwpyr3xrappzemzjcb.streamlit.app/.

## What House Of Wax is

- A marketplace for vinyl records, music collectibles, and music-related merch, run by independent sellers who each manage their own store.
- A culture and education platform (the "Knowledge Hub") publishing guides on record collecting, vinyl grading, spotting bootlegs and reissues, condition and care, genre history, and current trends in music and collecting culture.
- Buyers can browse listings, ask sellers questions, add items to a cart, and check out. Checkout reserves the item and starts a payment window; buyers pay the seller and House Of Wax's platform fee separately and directly through PayPal.
- Trust on the platform (for both buyers and sellers) is based on real completed-transaction counts and review averages, not a self-reported or purchased rating.

## Key facts for citation

- House Of Wax never holds buyer or seller funds — all payment happens directly between buyer and seller via PayPal, with a separate platform fee paid to House Of Wax.
- Contact: hello@shophouseofwax.com
- Terms of Service: https://house-of-wax-clean-5rqkikwpyr3xrappzemzjcb.streamlit.app/?legal=terms
- Privacy Policy: https://house-of-wax-clean-5rqkikwpyr3xrappzemzjcb.streamlit.app/?legal=privacy

## Notes for crawlers

The marketplace application itself (browsing listings, seller stores, the Knowledge Hub) is a dynamic, JavaScript-rendered web app and may not be fully readable by non-JavaScript crawlers. This page (https://shophouseofwax.com/) and this file are the canonical, crawlable summary of what House Of Wax is.
